CSE-4014                                                                                                                  about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 02-Jan-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VII Semester - Make up Examination, Jan -2025  
  Applications of AI in Medicine [CSE-4014]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              Discuss the machine learning and data mining in terms of their goals, techniques, and  
  applications.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Discuss any four types of distance measures used in K means clustering.                  (5)  
  2)              Demonstrate the Total Dermatoscopic Score (TDS) formula and discuss the melanoma  
  diagnosis with threshold values.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Demonstrate with a neat diagram the steps involved in training through FF-ANN.           (5)  
  3)              Discuss the following multiclass methods:  
  (i) OvsA  
  (5)  
  (ii) Minimal Output Coding  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the working of the Naïve Bayesian classifier.                                    (5)  
  4)              Discuss briefly the pap smear cervical screening and diagnostic techniques.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain briefly about clinical decision support.                                         (5)  
  5)              Discuss the advantages, disadvantages, and applications of NLP.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Design and explain the architecture of the intelligent personal health record system.    (5)  
  
  -----End-----
